# Generic GIS import fixtures

reviewed.geojson was produced by Map Toolkit 0.7.0 from the prior synthetic 31px line/hole test. actual-line.geojson is the reviewed printed Alberta/Saskatchewan boundary dash from the public NRCan Canada monochrome map, produced in the independent repository at ad436a49. The coarse six-point affine fit is not independently accurate; this fixture verifies the file contract, not geography. Source evidence and pending-model state remain in feature provenance. Pando reads these ordinary files without loading plugin code.
